ip_top_stories.title: Disney, Universal, and Warner Bros. Sue Midjourney Over AI Copyright Claims
ip_top_stories.summary: Major Hollywood studios have filed a copyright lawsuit against AI image generator Midjourney. In a countermove, Midjourney is seeking court orders to compel the studios to disclose their own internal AI use and practices, arguing this is relevant to the dispute.

ip_top_stories.title: Anthropic Faces New $75 Million Lawsuit Over Alleged Use of Pirated Books to Train Claude
ip_top_stories.summary: Anthropic has been hit with a new $75 million lawsuit alleging it used pirated books to train its Claude AI model. The case adds to growing litigation pressure on AI developers over training data and copyright.

ip_top_stories.title: AI copyright litigation yet to resolve key questions for publishers, PLS conference hears
ip_top_stories.summary: A Publishing Licensing Society conference heard that ongoing AI copyright litigation has yet to settle the fundamental questions that matter most to publishers, leaving significant uncertainty around training data rights and licensing frameworks.

ip_top_stories.title: Stability, Runway Trained AI on 100,000 Car Photos, Suit Says
ip_top_stories.summary: A new lawsuit claims that AI companies Stability AI and Runway trained their models on approximately 100,000 car photographs without authorisation, adding to the wave of copyright litigation targeting AI training data practices.

ip_top_stories.title: Madras High Court protects travel content from AI scraping in copyright infringement case
ip_top_stories.summary: India's Madras High Court has granted interim relief protecting travel content from alleged AI scraping, ruling in favour of the copyright holder in what is being noted as a significant AI-related copyright decision in the region.

ip_further_links.title: 47 Million AI Crawls in Six Hours Took stupidDOPE Offline. Publishers Deserve Protection.
ip_further_links.summary: A publisher reports being taken offline by an overwhelming volume of AI crawler traffic, renewing calls for legal protections for independent publishers against AI scraping.

ip_further_links.title: Independent Publishers Need Legal Protection From AI Crawlers Now
ip_further_links.summary: A commentary piece argues that independent publishers require urgent legislative protection against AI web crawlers that scrape content without consent or compensation.

ip_further_links.title: Congress doesn't have to choose between AI and copyright
ip_further_links.summary: A policy analysis argues that US Congress can craft legislation that supports AI innovation while preserving copyright protections, rejecting the framing of the two as mutually exclusive.

ip_further_links.title: Copyright holders 'in the dark' on PM's AI reforms: Violi
ip_further_links.summary: Copyright holders say they have been excluded from consultations on the Australian Prime Minister's AI reform agenda, raising concerns about transparency in policy development.

ip_further_links.title: 'Turning point': Anthropic's Australian ambitions collide with copyright wall
ip_further_links.summary: Anthropic's expansion into Australia is facing significant pushback over copyright concerns, with the country's legal and publishing sectors questioning AI training data practices.

ip_further_links.title: Getty Images vs. Stability AI: copyright explained
ip_further_links.summary: An explainer on the ongoing Getty Images lawsuit against Stability AI, outlining the key copyright questions at stake regarding AI training on licensed image libraries.

ip_further_links.title: Media, creative agencies' AI push faces copyright spotlight & policy uncertainty
ip_further_links.summary: Media and creative agencies accelerating AI adoption are facing increased scrutiny over copyright compliance and unresolved policy questions around AI-generated and AI-trained content.

ip_further_links.title: Who owns the copyright for AI-generated content?
ip_further_links.summary: An analysis of the unresolved legal question of copyright ownership in AI-generated works, examining current law and emerging case precedents.

ip_further_links.title: Pritzker signs landmark AI regulation bill into law
ip_further_links.summary: Illinois Governor Pritzker has signed a significant AI regulation bill into law, marking one of the more substantial pieces of US state-level AI legislation to date.

ip_further_links.title: I don't want a US tech bro as a patron - which is why artists must defend our copyright in the age of AI | Anna Funder
ip_further_links.summary: Author Anna Funder argues that artists must actively defend their copyright against AI companies, warning against dependence on big tech as a de facto patron of creative work.
